ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Care for widows? (1 mark)
   A. Say Care for widows has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Care for widows to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for widows.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an.
   D. Say Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

4. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   D. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Asbabu al- nuzuul? (1 mark)
   A. Use Asbabu al- nuzuul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asbabu al- nuzuul.
   C. Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Asbabu al- nuzuul has no place in daily life.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Selected verses Surah al- Furqan has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected verses Surah al- Furqan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses Surah al- Furqan.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Funeral Rites? (1 mark)
   A. Use Funeral Rites to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Funeral Rites.
   D. Say Funeral Rites has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Types of Divorce to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of Divorce.
   D. Say Types of Divorce has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn.
   B. Use Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prayers on special occasions has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Prayers on special occasions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions.
   D. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Types of verses? (1 mark)
   A. Use Types of verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of verses.
   C. Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Types of verses has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: manners of walking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: honesty 3.5 Prohibitions in Islam Page 15 of 80 xiii and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: honesty and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. B — Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. B — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. A — Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. D — Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Virtues: manners of walking; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Virtues: honesty 3.5 Prohibitions in Islam Page 15 of 80 xiii; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Virtues: honesty; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Prohibitions in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
